title: Yajurveda
author: The Veda of the sacrificial rite
intro: The Veda of the sacrificial formulas. Its fortieth chapter (Shukla Yajurveda) is the Isha Upanishad: eighteen verses opening with ईशा वास्यमिदं सर्वम्. It is given here in full, with its peace prayer ॐ पूर्णमदः and two famous shanti mantras from the Yajurveda's Upanishads: असतो मा सद्गमय and सह नाववतु.
note: The Isha Upanishad follows the commonly printed Kanva text. Vedic accent marks are not shown.
